1. Write the setup files
  ● wrote argus-reviewer.config.ts
  ● wrote tests/argus/smoke.test.ts
  ● wrote .github/workflows/argus-reviewer.yml
  ● wrote .github/workflows/argus-mention.yml

2. Check the argus-reviewer environment
  ⊘ openrouter key  not set (BYOK, required for model calls)
      export OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-...
  <glyph> playwright      <host-dependent>
  ◌ github          gh not authenticated (enables PR workflows)
      gh auth login
  – agent zero      not found (optional; enables `verify --a0` delegation)
    models        vision google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite (docs/models.md)
                  code deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
                  escalation moonshotai/kimi-k2.5

What runs and what it costs:
  sent to provider  PR diffs, page screenshots/DOM snapshots, and
                    review prompts — via your OpenRouter key (BYOK)
  default budget    $1/run cap (budgetUsd); cached replay costs $0
  how to stop       Ctrl+C locally; in CI remove the workflow file
                    or delete the OPENROUTER_API_KEY secret

3. Run the default lane (code review)
      argus-reviewer verify
    Then: point target.url at your app for the flow and app lanes,
    record a real flow with argus-reviewer record "...", and add
    OPENROUTER_API_KEY to the repo secrets to enable the PR workflow.
